**Finding: missing (critical)** — no indemnity of any kind exists in this Agreement.

**Investigation**
- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "claim" returned no hits; only p0046 mentions "infringing" (a mutual advertising-content covenant, not an indemnity).
- Read the full document: HDI's responsibilities (§1), Company's responsibilities (§2), fees (§3), term/termination (§4), site management (§5), exclusivity/licence of Marks (§6), cross-promotions (§7), confidentiality (§8), Warranties (§9 — only corporate-authority reps plus a Globix carve-out), General Provisions (§10). Section 9 runs straight into Section 10 with no defence obligation.
- HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site and supplies the software, tools and technology, so third-party IP infringement risk sits squarely with it — yet the Company carries it unprotected. That is the rule's walk-away scenario.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — new Section 9A inserted after p0058, at the preferred position:
- 9A.1: HDI defends/indemnifies the Company and affiliates for (a) IP infringement/misappropriation by the Site, Services or HDI deliverables (carve-out for Company-supplied Content and Marks), (b) HDI's breach of law, (c) HDI-caused unauthorised access to Content/Confidential Information/customer data, (d) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct — with notice, control-of-defence (no adverse settlement without our consent) and cooperation at HDI's expense.
- 9A.2: our reciprocal indemnity deliberately narrow — Company-provided Content/Marks and our own breach of law.
- Conforming amendment to the §10.7 survival list to include 9A.
